observations: Photo 0: a bare car engine on a shop floor, out of the vehicle, shot from above at an angle.
Photo 0: a Toyota logo is cast on the valve cover; the cover style looks like a Toyota VVT-i petrol four cylinder.
Photo 0: a small yellow sticker with red handwriting sits on the valve cover but the engine code on it is not reliably legible at this resolution.
Photo 0: cooling fan with clutch, power steering pump and reservoir, alternator side belts and wiring harness still attached; intake pipe on top.
Photo 0: surfaces are dusty and oily, consistent with a used imported engine; no cracks or broken parts visible from this angle.
Photo 0: one photo only, watermarked with the seller's name and a phone camera stamp; no engine code stamp on the block, no gearbox, no running clip.

identity.kind: used Toyota petrol engine (engine code not legible)

claims.evidence: No paperwork shown; the seller's own text also says direct from Belgium, so the origin story conflicts with itself.
Origin cannot be seen in a photo and conflicts with 'Direct Japan' in the same advert.
A seller promise, not visible in any photo; no written terms shown.
Photo 0 is a still of an engine out of the car; no running clip or compression test shown.
A loose engine carries no odometer; nothing in photo 0 shows mileage.
Photo 0 shows the top only; no close shots of head and sump gasket lines or bolt heads for tool marks.

risks.risk: Engine code unknown: the Toyota family covers engines of very different value, so the wrong code means the wrong price.
risks.proof: A close, sharp photo of the engine code stamped on the block and the full sticker on the valve cover.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; code required before any price

risks.risk: Engine does not run, knocks, or has low compression.
risks.proof: A clip of the engine started on a test stand or in a car, with sound, from cold start to idle, plus a compression gauge reading per cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, a core for parts

risks.risk: Engine has been opened and rebuilt or has a blown head gasket.
risks.proof: Close photos of the head to block joint, sump gasket and head bolts, and a photo of the oil under the filler cap.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillaries not shown from this angle (starter, injectors, ECU, sensors, other side of the block).
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides of the engine and the underside, with ancillaries in view.
risks.if_unproven: as a long block only, ancillaries excluded

risks.risk: Cracked block or head, or water in the oil, hidden from a top view.
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and oil filler cap underside, and of the block sides near the freeze plugs.

proof_requests: Sharp close photo of the engine code stamped on the block, and of the valve cover sticker.
Clip of the engine running on a stand with sound, from start to idle.
Photos of all four sides and the underside of the engine with ancillaries in view.
Close photos of the head and sump gasket lines and head bolts, and of the oil under the filler cap.
Written terms of the 2 months guarantee.
response.reason: The Toyota logo is readable in photo 0 but the engine code that sets the price is not, and Toyota engines differ widely in value, so not even a worst case price can be set until the code is shown.
